statement: The stipulated G=8 W/K design reaches 30 C at 268.76 s
The stipulated G=12 W/K design reaches 30 C at 179.18 s
Both designs remove 60000 J by the prescribed threshold independent of G
At fixed initial and ambient and target temperatures time is proportional to 1/G so the 12 W/K design is faster
Normalized excess temperature is exp(-Gt/C) and the threshold satisfies Gtstar/C=ln(6)
The prescribed conductance scenarios change threshold time by +11.11 or -9.09 percent and preserve the design ordering
The uniform-temperature assumption can fail if internal heat redistribution is slow and cannot be quantified with the supplied inputs
The complete English manuscript covers all specified practice questions and labels model results and limitations
